project: SP-009 / DOC-2-076 Enzyme Families as Evolutionary Laboratories
estimand: Does natural substitution pattern (family-evolution flexibility) improve variant-effect prediction beyond conservation and family-profile baselines on held-out enzyme families? (prediction, not discovery/classification)
commercial_boundary: enzyme-engineering mutation prioritization with calibrated abstention and reviewer traceability; never proof of catalytic activity or safety; a useful negative (family evolution adds nothing beyond conservation) is a deliverable

PPM1D.chem: metal-dependent Ser/Thr phosphoprotein phosphatase (hydrolase, distinct chemistry vs BLAT)

AMIE_backup.chem: amidase-signature Ser-cisSer-Lys triad (backup family, used only if a primary family fails an R1 gate)

label_semantics_frozen: DMS_score_bin==1 <=> DMS_score >= DMS_binarization_cutoff (functional/tolerated); bin==0 = damaging. Verified deterministically on OXDA_expression and HXK4_activity with zero exceptions. Cutoffs per assay from ProteinGym reference CSV (never re-derived).

assay_quality_floors_frozen.both_classes_present: >=250 variants per class per primary assay (OXDA_activity secondary flagged: 281 damaging; primary OXDA_expression 1329/5440)
assay_quality_floors_frozen.coordinate_mapping: mutant position p requires target_seq[p-1]==WT amino acid, asserted for every scored variant

holdouts_frozen: leave-one-family-out CV over the 5 primary families (5 folds); ALL assays of a held-out family excluded from training in that fold; AMIE_backup not part of CV
leakage_exclusions_frozen: no training family may share any Pfam domain with the held-out family (structurally guaranteed by selection; asserted)
pairwise cross-family target-sequence identity screen: best-window identity must be <0.30 (measured <=0.112 all pairs; results/cross_family_identity_screen.json)
the assayed target sequence itself is excluded from its own family alignment before scoring (no self-scoring circularity)

raw DMS scores never pooled across assays; per-assay bin labels (frozen ProteinGym cutoffs) are the only cross-assay comparable target; continuous analyses use per-assay rank/z-score computed within training families only
flexibility_scores_frozen: site_entropy: Shannon entropy of the family-alignment column (bits, 20-letter + gap handling frozen in code)
site_rel_entropy: KL divergence of column distribution vs UniProt background amino-acid frequencies
substitution_spectrum: per-column observed amino-acid frequency vector (the natural substitution pattern) used as 20-dim feature
profile_llr: log-likelihood ratio of mutant vs WT amino acid under the family PSSM (pseudocount 0.5 frozen)
conservation_baselines_frozen: PSSM WT-vs-mut log-odds (equals profile_llr sign-flipped baseline kept deliberately to test incremental value)
candidate_models_frozen: ridge regression on continuous per-assay z-scored DMS
feature ablations: conservation-only, profile-only, flexibility-only, all - the ablation IS the primary question
r1_primary_metric_frozen: per-held-out-family ROC-AUC on bin labels and Spearman on continuous scores; candidate(all-features) must beat both conservation-only and profile-only ablations with variant-level bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero in at least 4 of 5 families to claim incremental value; per-family abstention when a feature group is non-estimable (e.g., alignment column coverage <80% of assayed positions); calibration gate: reliability slope within [0.5,2.0] on held-out family
non_estimability_clauses: if coordinate mapping fails for any variant class -> family excluded and recorded
if family alignment yields <80% column coverage of assayed positions -> flexibility features non-estimable for that family, recorded, family still scored on baselines
if cross-family identity screen had failed -> project non-estimable as designed
